<documents>
<document id="security-account-takeover">
IfˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆelseˆhasˆsignedˆinˆtoˆyourˆaccount,ˆactˆfast.ˆ##ˆSignsˆtoˆlookˆforˆ-ˆAˆpasswordˆchangeˆorˆnew-deviceˆsign-inˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆ-ˆYourˆemailˆaddressˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆchangedˆwithoutˆyouˆ-ˆTransfersˆorˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆyouˆdidn'tˆsendˆ-ˆYou'reˆsuddenlyˆsignedˆoutˆandˆcan'tˆsignˆbackˆinˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆin,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆfreezeˆyourˆcards.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆcallˆusˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆ##ˆWhatˆwe'llˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆandˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆaccountˆtakeovers.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆusuallyˆmuchˆfaster.ˆTheyˆmayˆsignˆoutˆeveryˆdevice,ˆresetˆyourˆcredentialsˆandˆreviewˆrecentˆactivityˆwithˆyou.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆtransfersˆorˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆduringˆaˆtakeoverˆinvestigation.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆdoesˆthatˆonceˆthey'veˆconfirmedˆwhoˆyouˆare.ˆ##ˆAfterwardˆCheckˆyourˆemailˆaccount'sˆsecurityˆtoo.ˆManyˆtakeoversˆstartˆwithˆaˆcompromisedˆemail.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-fraud-lock">
WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆ"LockedˆbyˆTallowbrook",ˆourˆfraudˆsystemsˆhaveˆplacedˆaˆfraudˆlockˆonˆit.ˆThisˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆaˆfreezeˆyouˆsetˆyourself.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆWeˆlockˆaˆcardˆwhenˆweˆseeˆactivityˆthatˆlooksˆlikeˆfraud,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆfraudˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆgetˆitˆremovedˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆanˆopenˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆanswerˆit.ˆTappingˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆusuallyˆremovesˆtheˆlockˆstraightˆaway.ˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆnoˆalert,ˆmessageˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆtheˆFraudˆteam.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆandˆneitherˆcanˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆoftenˆmuchˆsooner.ˆ##ˆMeanwhileˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆstillˆarriveˆwhileˆyourˆcardˆisˆlocked.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆstillˆuseˆBrookPayˆandˆtransfers,ˆunlessˆtheˆFraudˆteamˆhasˆrestrictedˆthoseˆtoo.ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆfraudˆalertˆbyˆgivingˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcode.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What's the direct phone number for the Fraud team?
